count_definitions.displayed_source_provider_entries: Distinct source/provider labels displayed in the installed-build evidence; On Device is counted as a displayed option even though it does not identify a component.
count_definitions.verified_named_components: Distinct named sources or providers supported by current installed-build or current first-party public evidence.
count_definitions.inferred_components: Implementation identities inferred from platform-facing UI but not named by Nihongo.
count_definitions.historical_unconfirmed_components: Named providers found only in historical local observations and not recaptured from the installed build.
count_definitions.unknown_component_capabilities: Capability rows for which no exact implementation or complete source stack is identified.
count_definitions.licensing_blockers: Gap groups requiring a contract, permission, license-path decision, or clip-level rights proof before exact reuse.
count_definitions.unresolved_gaps: Stable gap groups below; a group may affect more than one claim.

component_constraints.license_and_attribution: EDRDG's current terms use CC BY-SA 4.0 and require source/license acknowledgement, links, and a regular update procedure.
component_constraints.redistribution_and_use: Commercial local/offline use is possible from a pinned upstream snapshot while preserving provenance and share-alike obligations.
component_constraints.network_privacy_offline: Public downloadable data can be used locally; no runtime network or personal-data transfer is inherent.

component_constraints.license_and_attribution: General text exports are CC BY 2.0 FR with a CC0 subset; sentence, contributor, and license attribution must be retained. Audio rights are per contributor and an empty audio-license field forbids outside reuse.
component_constraints.redistribution_and_use: Pinned text exports are usable with per-item provenance; audio is not reusable by default.
component_constraints.network_privacy_offline: Public text exports support local/offline use; no runtime network or personal-data transfer is inherent.

component_constraints.license_and_attribution: CJKI licenses lexical datasets case by case; the installed build does not display the exact product or contract.
component_constraints.redistribution_and_use: Mobile/offline distribution, fields, term, updates, attribution, and derivative-display rights require a negotiated agreement.
component_constraints.network_privacy_offline: Nihongo displays the data inline and describes more than 75,000 entries, but delivery and runtime network behavior are not exposed.

component_constraints.license_and_attribution: Supported modern UniDic releases offer GPL 2.0, LGPL 2.1, or New BSD alternatives; one path must be deliberately selected and documented.
component_constraints.redistribution_and_use: Potentially bundleable after the matching release, exact role, transforms, and selected license path are pinned.
component_constraints.network_privacy_offline: UniDic is normally local data; the installed screen does not expose Nihongo's packaging or update channel.

component_constraints.license_and_attribution: English Wiktionary text is available under CC BY-SA 4.0/GFDL subject to revision-level attribution; embedded media and quotations can differ.
component_constraints.redistribution_and_use: Zenbu can independently derive from cited upstream revisions, but cannot copy Nihongo's authored selection or expression.
component_constraints.network_privacy_offline: A pinned, provenance-preserving derivative can be local/offline; live access is not required.

component_constraints.license_and_attribution: Revision-level Wikimedia licensing and attribution apply; the installed build does not identify revisions or copied fields.
component_constraints.redistribution_and_use: Independent use is possible after revision pinning and attribution review, without copying Nihongo's synthesis.
component_constraints.network_privacy_offline: A pinned derivative can be local/offline; live access is not required.

component_constraints.license_and_attribution: No reusable license or permission was established for the consulted Shinjigen material.
component_constraints.redistribution_and_use: Treat direct content reuse as unavailable absent permission; independently establish non-copyrightable facts where appropriate.
component_constraints.network_privacy_offline: No runtime service dependency is established.

component_constraints.license_and_attribution: Google Cloud Vision is a commercial API governed by Google Cloud terms, not a redistributable component.
component_constraints.redistribution_and_use: Zenbu can contract with the service but must not represent access as ownership or redistribution.
component_constraints.network_privacy_offline: Network and selected-image transmission are required for this mode; public provider documentation says request content is not used to train Cloud Vision and images are normally deleted after processing with a short failsafe retention path.

component_constraints.license_and_attribution: OCR.space offers API plans under its service terms; limits and commercial posture depend on the selected plan.
component_constraints.redistribution_and_use: Zenbu can call the service under an appropriate plan but cannot redistribute the provider itself.
component_constraints.network_privacy_offline: Network and selected-image transmission are required; public provider documentation says uploads are deleted after processing, searchable PDFs after 60 minutes, and API IP logs after one month.

component_constraints.license_and_attribution: Unknown because the displayed option does not name an implementation.
component_constraints.redistribution_and_use: Unknown; Apple Vision is only a candidate and cannot be treated as the Nihongo component.
component_constraints.network_privacy_offline: The option is displayed as On Device and as lacking vertical-text support, but the exact isolation, model, fallback, and data handling remain unverified.

component_constraints.license_and_attribution: Platform API and voice usage would follow Apple's terms; Nihongo does not name the API.
component_constraints.redistribution_and_use: Zenbu can use supported platform speech APIs but must not redistribute system voice assets or claim exact Nihongo equivalence without behavioral proof.
component_constraints.network_privacy_offline: Availability varies with installed/downloaded system voices; the installed screen directs downloads through iOS Settings and excludes Siri voices, but offline and fallback behavior remain unverified.

component_constraints.license_and_attribution: The historical Tofugu/WaniKani pronunciation repository is CC BY-SA 4.0 with attribution, but current Nihongo attribution and clip equivalence were not recaptured.
component_constraints.redistribution_and_use: Do not reuse a clip until its identity, edits, speaker mapping, and license are crosswalked.
component_constraints.network_privacy_offline: Public files can be bundled locally if cleared; Nihongo's download/cache behavior remains unknown.

component_constraints.license_and_attribution: Most Kanji Alive original language data and media is CC BY 4.0 with explicit exceptions; current Nihongo attribution and clip equivalence were not recaptured.
component_constraints.redistribution_and_use: Do not reuse a clip until its identity, exception status, edits, and attribution are crosswalked.
component_constraints.network_privacy_offline: Cleared public files may be local; Nihongo's download/cache behavior remains unknown.

gaps.completed_independent_work: JMdict is verified as the named upstream.

gaps.missing: Nihongo's Tatoeba snapshot, filtering, ordering, associations, local edits, and audio selection
gaps.completed_independent_work: Tatoeba is verified as the named text upstream.
gaps.resume_procedure: Pin a licensed export and crosswalk sentence IDs, contributors, licenses, ordering, and a representative installed-build sample.

gaps.missing: Exact CJKI product, version, fields, transformations, delivery format, and mobile/offline/derivative-display rights
gaps.completed_independent_work: The installed build directly names CJK Dictionary Institute as the pitch-accent provider.
gaps.resume_procedure: Ask CJKI to identify the delivery corresponding to Nihongo's displayed fields and quote mobile distribution, offline bundling, updates, and derivative-display rights.

gaps.missing: UniDic version, exact supplemental fields/role, transformation, and chosen license path
gaps.completed_independent_work: The installed build directly says pitch data is supplemented by the UniDic project.
gaps.resume_procedure: Identify the matching UniDic release and fields through data comparison or provider confirmation, then select and document one applicable GPL/LGPL/New BSD path before bundling.

gaps.missing: Exact Wiktionary revisions, selection and transformation boundaries, original-versus-derived content, image rights, and permission for Shinjigen-derived material
gaps.completed_independent_work: The installed build names English Wiktionary as primary and names Japanese Wiktionary and Shinjigen as consulted sources; it also states the developer resolves conflicts using personal judgment.
gaps.resume_procedure: Build a revision-level citation set from independently accessed sources, retain Wikimedia obligations, obtain Shinjigen permission or exclude its expression, and author Zenbu's own synthesis without copying Nihongo's prose or images.

gaps.missing: Provider request mode, image preprocessing, configuration, retries, limits, and binding of earlier captured runs to the then-selected provider
gaps.completed_independent_work: The installed build lists Google and OCR.space and showed Google selected on the capture date.
gaps.resume_procedure: Run purpose-created fixtures under each explicitly selected provider, recording preconditions, network behavior, output, errors, retries, and restoration to the starting selection.

gaps.missing: Identity, version, supported systems/languages, trigger, accuracy, and fallback policy for the displayed On Device option
gaps.completed_independent_work: The installed build verifies an On Device option and states that it does not support vertical text.
gaps.resume_procedure: Execute the deterministic image fixture matrix with On Device selected and controlled network isolation; seek first-party confirmation or authorized metadata before naming an engine.

gaps.missing: Current installed-build provider attribution, exact clip IDs, speakers, edits, formats, coverage, mixed-provider fallback, exceptions, and clip-level rights
gaps.completed_independent_work: The installed Voice screen verifies human recordings exist and synthetic fallback is used when unavailable; WaniKani/Tofugu and Kanji Alive remain historical leads only.
gaps.resume_procedure: Locate a current attribution surface or obtain provider confirmation, then crosswalk public clips using stable metadata or authorized hashes and verify every retained clip's license and exceptions.

gaps.missing: Exact API, voice identifiers, fallback order, preprocessing, rate/pitch mapping, overrides, offline behavior, and audio-session behavior
gaps.completed_independent_work: The installed Voice screen lists Kyoko, O-ren, and Otoya regular/enhanced system voices, directs downloads through iOS Settings, excludes Siri voices, and states the configured synthetic voice is the fallback.
gaps.resume_procedure: Capture the selected system voice identifiers and behavior under controlled fixtures, compare candidate Apple speech output, and retain the API identity as inference until first-party or authorized metadata confirms it.

gaps.missing: Index, corpora, weights, normalization, prefix/fuzzy rules, tie-breaks, and commonality transforms
gaps.completed_independent_work: Observable fixture outputs and current public inputs are cross-indexed.
gaps.resume_procedure: Use the existing behavior matrix to compare candidate index/ranking implementations without naming one as Nihongo's internal implementation.

gaps.missing: Analyzer, lexicon, versions, token boundaries, lattice/ranking rules, lemma resolution, and deinflection integration
gaps.completed_independent_work: Lemma and boundary outputs are observed across Search and Image Text fixtures.
gaps.resume_procedure: Run isolating synthetic token/deinflection fixtures against candidate analyzers and preserve every mismatch; do not infer the internal engine from similar output.

gaps.completed_independent_work: Representative installed conjugation tables are captured.
gaps.resume_procedure: Complete the representative class denominator and compare every displayed form plus reverse-search behavior against an independently authored ruleset.

gaps.missing: Recognizer, model/version, training data, normalization, supported set, stroke-order sensitivity, candidate ranking, and offline behavior

gaps.resume_procedure: Execute controlled stroke-order, reversal, partial, kana, non-jōyō, extra-stroke, erase, and cancel fixtures; treat candidate engines as substitutes until independently identified.

gaps.missing: Exact upstreams, snapshots, local corrections, element ontology, decomposition graph, stroke paths, diagram generation, and classification mappings
gaps.completed_independent_work: Installed kanji, radical, element, and stroke behavior is captured; public KANJIDIC2, RADKFILE/KRADFILE, and KanjiVG remain candidates, not confirmed Nihongo sources.
gaps.resume_procedure: Crosswalk a declared sample against candidate datasets and seek current attribution or provider confirmation before generalizing any match.

gaps.owner: Image Text Recognition and Japanese Text Analysis owners

gaps.completed_independent_work: Observable grouping is captured, including a vertical cross-column limitation.

privacy_and_scope.retained_content: Only app-owned settings, public source/provider labels, public explanatory text, and system voice labels are retained.
privacy_and_scope.not_retained: The Nihongo Pro screen exposed unrelated entitlement information and was immediately left without saving an artifact. No account identity, receipt, credential, personal history, photo, file, or clipboard payload was captured.
privacy_and_scope.settings_boundary: Only the Settings index and Voice, Dictionary, Kanji Etymology, and Photo Lookup paths needed for source provenance were inventoried. All other Settings destinations remain excluded.
